profile.headline: Front End Software Engineer at DigitalOcean
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Front-end software engineer and MBA with more than 5 years of experience building web applications. Special expertise in adapting to a range of frameworks, collaborating with multi-functional teams, ensuring accessibility across technologies, and transforming wireframes into rich, front-end experiences. Strong team player with a commitment to mentoring junior developers and staying engaged with new technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Front-End Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Plan, scope, and develop new features, in addition to leading code reviews and pair programming with junior engineers, for an audience engagement platform that serves media clients across North America
•  Collaborated with the product and design teams to develop a new UI initiative, leading to an 8-point Net Promoter Score increase in 1 year
•  Added custom HTML input fields to a drag-and-drop email template builder written in TypeScript to empower clients to further customize their email templates
•  Expanded support for mobile downloads and website visits by adding new form field types to increase click tracking, boosting engagement and advertising potential for more than 1k promotions

positions.title: Vice President of Analytics
positions.description:
•  Led analytics and financial performance for a family-owned hospitality management company, and developed and maintained internal web applications and tools 
•  Implemented bank web scraping and emailing automation script in Python with Selenium, increasing the speed of the monthly accounting compliance workflow by 6x
•  Developed an analytics tool to compare KPIs for the company portfolio in PostgreSQL and Django before later migrating the front end to React

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
•  Scoped new client projects and planned sprints, in addition to mentoring junior developers, for a content marketing agency
•  Developed a quote-building tool in React to interact with a secure insurance API in Node.js, and oversaw the onboarding and React training for 2 developers while maintaining documentation on best practices
•  Maintained Drupal theming for different cereal brands, and created interactive blog post elements for a home security system brand
•  Increased performance and added social media feeds to an Electron app that powered the office’s 30-foot video wall
